## 📝 Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Include any context necessary to understand the change.

> **Example:** This PR adds user authentication using JWT tokens and includes login/logout functionality.

## 🧪 Testing Instructions

- Describe how the changes were tested.
- Include specific steps reviewers should take to validate the behavior.

> **Example:**
> 1. Clone the branch
> 2. Run `npm install && npm start`
> 3. Navigate to `/login` and test login with mock credentials
> 4. Ensure token is stored and routes are protected

Implements #[feature number]
